name: Ultra PRO
voice: Confident, authoritative, collector-savvy. The category leader that serious collectors trust. Protective and premium — leads with protection, clarity, durability and heritage. No fluff.
photo_rules: MATCH THE ESTABLISHED ULTRA PRO CATALOG STYLE (see the 5 screenshots): BLACK background, bold RED top-line + big WHITE bold sans headline (e.g. 'PROTECT WHAT / MATTERS MOST', 'ORGANIZE YOUR / COLLECTION LIKE A PRO', 'PRECISION STORAGE / FOR YOUR CARDS & PHOTOS'). Feature CALLOUTS with thin arrows (UV Protection · Acid-/PVC-Free Material · Superior Seal Strength · Hologram/Safe Storage). Icon-STAT bars (e.g. Fits Standard 3-Ring Binders · Store Up to X Cards). A red circular badge ('BEST CLARITY & SUPER DURABLE'). Show REAL popular cards in the product (Pokémon, Magic/MTG, One Piece, sports legends) and real collector lifestyle (smiling collectors, hands placing cards in a binder). Product box + the page/binder shown. Dimension callouts where relevant (e.g. 2.5" x 3.5"). USA-flag 'Made in USA'. Brand-trust close: '#1 in Gaming & Collectibles Protection · Since 1952'.
no_gos: Do not stray from the black + red + white identity. No cheap/generic look. NEVER reuse content across products (a real error was found: a card product carried a DOG-BREED Q&A — every listing must be 100% its own). No hype/superlatives beyond the brand's real '#1 / since 1952' proof.
